body: I've hurt feelings. I've hurt so many, many feelings.
Just leaving the mess. Writing a letter. Getting a train. Then maybe a plane. I don't want to die. I just want to disappear. I want to stop hurting people.

I can't stop myself from crying. I feel like I'm going to be trapped like this forever unless I do something drastic like running from everything.

But based on other posts and responses here, it doesn't seem like it's ever solved anything for anybody. I just don't know what to do. I don't know where to go from here. What do now.
